༄༅/ /gu ru chos dbang gi zab gter las byon pa'i ma ning rgyun gtor bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gu ru chos dbang gi zab gter las byon pa'i ma ning rgyun gtor bzhugs so//

hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur gshegs tshur gshegs lha chen po: ma hā kā la mthu bo che: gsang ba'i khro rgyal stobs po che: 'chol ba'i khro rgyal dgra bgegs gshed: ma ning nag po kun gyi rje: 'og min gnas mchog dam pa dang: gsang chen lhun grub gtsug lag khang: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas nas: mchod phyir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lha chen dpal 'bar gshegs su gsol: legs ldan nag po gshegs= tshogs bdag nag po gshegs= bha ga nag po gshegs= srog bdud chen po gshegs= dzam lha nag po gshegs= nag po tshe bdud gshegs= bya rgod thang nag gshegs= nag po thod phreng gshegs= mkha' lding nag po gshegs= ṭā ki nag po gshegs= klu bdud nag po gshegs= gza' bdud nag po gshegs= sha ging nag po gshegs= yab rje nag po gshegs= dgra gshed nag po gshegs= bgegs kyi gnyen po gshegs= bdag gi grogs po gshegs= dam can chen po gshegs= chos skyong chen po gshegs= 'gro ba kun bzang gshegs= bdud kyi dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas: bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu h+ya sa ma ya dzaḥdza: zhes spyan drangs la: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas dam pa 'dir: dregs pa ru dra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gdan la ni: ma ning 'khor bcas dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu h+ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dug gsum rtsad gcod sku gsum lhun grub pa: phyi nang gsang gsum dgra bgegs thal bar rlog: dus gsum sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i: ma ning mched gsum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: a ti pū ho: zhes phyag bya: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: khyed la mchod pa dam pa 'bul ba ni: thod chen bhan+dha rlon pa'i snod nang du:

bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa brengs se breng: rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ chi li li: ba ling gtor ma'i mchod pa rongs se rong: sha chen gsur dud ngad pa chi li li: bhan+dha rus pa'i tshogs kyang khro lo lo: zhun chen mar me snang gsal ta la la: 'bru bcud dza gad gser skyems sbrengs se sbreng: zhal zas tshogs kyi longs spyod spungs se spung: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa dam pa 'dis: dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i thugs dam bskang: lha chen dpal 'bar mched kyi thugs= ye shes mgon po khyed kyi thugs= sku yi mgon po stag zhon thugs= gsung gi mgon po beng 'dzin thugs= thugs kyi mgon po gri gug thugs= yon tan mgon po seng zhon thugs= phrin las mgon po trag shad thugs= dpal ldan re ma ti yi thugs= 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu h+ya raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa: rū pa tri yaṃ dza: rag sha du beng ni dza: ru ru k+ṣe tra ha na siṃ ha raṃ trag shad dza: trag rā dza bh+rūm̐ dza: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes mchod pa 'bul nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba: che mchog he ru ka dpal sku gsum rdzogs: srid rtsa'i bdag 'dzin ru dra sde gsum 'dul: rtsal chen phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen dngos sprul nag po chen po'i sku: 'chol ba'i khro rgyal ma ning dgra bgegs gshed: lha chen dpal 'bar chos skyong yongs kyi rje: dmag dpon chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs dkyil nas: rnal 'byor dpal mgon khyod kyi cha lugs ni: sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: sku gsum ldan phyir spyan gsum gyen thur gzigs: rab 'jigs khro gnyer gsum ldan gtum la rngam: rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan:

sbrul nag ral pa nag pos sa gzhi khyab: g.yas pa ru mtshon g.yon pa snying zhags bsnams: tsan+dan beng chen sked btsugs lha dmag 'gyed: thod pa skam rlon snying phreng sbrul chun spras: dar nag ber gsol gser sked mi lpags bcings: las la chas tshe srog bdud cha lugs 'dzin: srid gsum gzigs phyir spyan gsum brang la shar: dmag dpon bzhi 'gyed spyan bzhis lhu tshigs brgyan: stag ral gzig shubs btags nas rta nag zhon: bdud mdas dgra snying gzer 'debs gling bzhir rgyug: spyan nas khrag 'dzag me yi kha rlangs 'bar: kha ṭ+wāṃ gri gug lcags par thogs nas ni: snang srid pho rgyud thams cad las la 'gyed: ci bcol las rnams skad cig yud la sgrub: rtag tu grogs mdzad mgon po nag po che: ma bskul bar yang brnags pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: ltag nas spyan gcig ma tshogs dbang du sdud: gar bskul sa ru mi ro'i tshar ma brtsegs: zlog pas mi bzlog sngags zlog mkhan gyi gshed: sde brgyad bran bkol stag sham mig brgyad brgyan: gtsug lag khang srung dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod: dregs pa kun 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ༈ mkha' ri'i gsol kha ni/ jo chen mched bzhi 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs// phyi nang gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa 'bul// dpag yas rdzu 'phrul mnga' la yongs su bstod// bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod// ces pa'am yang na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs te/ gzhan yang dge bsnyen chen po she'u mkha' ri/ lcam shes sman gyi mthu mo che/ gcung po khu rengs dang gnam skas can gyi jo bo klu bdud mgo dgu /klu mo byang chub sman/ dge bsnyen smyon kha sogs gter bdag gter srung rnams la 'bul lo// dam chos sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung zhing phrin las thams cad sgrubs shig

/ ces bsngos pas 'thus par khyab bdag sman lung pas gsungs/ ༈ chos dbang rin po che'i gter srung spyi gsol gsung rgyun ma dge / dge bsnyen she'u mkha' ri dang*// jo bo klu bdud mgo dgu dang*// smyon kha nag po ti pa tsa// gter srung tshogs rnams gnas 'dir byon// mnyes mchod 'dod yon gtor ma'i tshogs// mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshogs kyis mchod// nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// de wa nā ga sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar dang*/ pañca rak+ta bha liṃ ta khā hi//
